title: アドバンストバイオ工学
subtitle: Advanced Bioengineering
educationalGoal: The goals are to utilize the knowledges learned in Applied Bioscience and you will understand the advanced-bioengineering field. In this course, you can understand and explain the history of the industrial use in the biotechnology fields including food, pharmaceutical product, and environment. You will learn the fundamental phenomena to the latest findings in bioengineering processes, especially food processing for utilize the knowledge in your future studies.
advice: Outline of this course 1. History of the bioengineering and its application to various fields 2. Bioengineering in food processing process 3. Basic and advanced knowledge of food technology A quiz will be given on the next week of each lecture. Advice of this course 1. Understand the basic and major experiments. 2. Understand the basic characteristics of the major components of food in "Food and Nutrition" and other courses. 3. Quantitative understanding of the complex systems such as foods.
requiredKnowledge: Requires completion of the “Introduction to Bioengineering”, “Microbiology”, and “Food and Nutrition” courses.

activityGoals.body: Understand the basic findings in the field of bioengineering and the research trends of these industries.
Understand the risks of the biological experiments.
Understand the techniques in the field of food processing.
Understand the evaluation techniques such as food analysis.
